cim: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
cim_eredeti: Seattle-based StepSecurity, which offers a software supply chain security platform, raised a $20M Series A led by Elephant, bringing its total funding to $23M (Chris Metinko/Axios)
szoveg_eredeti:
Cybersecurity startup StepSecurity raised a $20 million Series A led by Elephant, co-founders Varun Sharma and Ashish Kurmi tell Axios Pro exclusively.

Why it matters: This week showed what a software supply chain attack can do, as have the recent Claude Code extension and Binance incidents.

prioritas.indok: Bár megemlíti a Claude Code incidenseket, ez elsősorban egy általános kiberbiztonsági startup tőkebevonási híre.
prioritas.cim_hu: Húszmillió dolláros tőkebevonással erősíti a szoftverellátási lánc védelmét a StepSecurity
prioritas.lead_hu: A seattle-i StepSecurity 20 millió dolláros Series A finanszírozási kört zárt le az Elephant vezetésével. A kiberbiztonsági cég a szoftverellátási láncok védelmére szakosodott.
